regression.title: Auto MPG
regression.name: Auto MPG
regression.summary: The fuel consumption of 70s and 80s cars, in miles per gallon, from their engine, weight and year.

text: The AUTO MPG dataset was taken from the StatLib library maintained at Carnegie Mellon University. The dataset was used at the 1983 American Statistical Association Exposition.

The term "Auto MPG" refers to miles per gallon, a unit of fuel efficiency measurement commonly used in the United States. This measure indicates how many miles a vehicle can travel on one gallon of fuel. However, "Auto MPG" is an English term and there is no direct translation in Spanish.

In Spanish, terms such as "consumo de combustible" or "rendimiento de combustible" are often used to refer to the fuel efficiency of a car. These terms indicate how many kilometres or miles a vehicle can travel on one litre or gallon of fuel, respectively.

It is important to note that different countries use different units of measurement for fuel consumption. For example, in some places the litre per 100 kilometres travelled (L/100 km) is used to indicate fuel efficiency.
For more information about this dataset, visit the <link1>ICS.UCI.edu repository.</link1>

sections.title: Information
items: MPG: MPG is Miles Per Gallon. This is the amount of fuel consumed by the particular vehicle of an instance. This variable can also be used as the variable to be predicted for any car
cylinders: This attribute describes the number of cylinders of each car. This is a discrete valued attribute
displacement: This is another attribute of the vehicle which has a quantitative continuous value describing the engine displacement
horsepower: This attribute tells about the horsepower of a car and is a continuous valued variable
weight: This refers to the weight of each car which is a continuous valued quantitative variable
model year: The year the model was released is mentioned in this attribute
origin: The origin attribute has 3 discrete values. 1 refers to cars made in USA, 2 for Europe and 3 for Asia
car name: This is the name of the car in string
